purpose: Independently reconcile the MIR4 Research Library's omitted-research explanation capability with published MIR5.0.14 and current-dev Availability before stable; retain a finite, reviewable parity requirement without restoring the retired compiler or claiming native execution.

inputs.source_identity: Both inspected MIR5 availability and library blobs match their respective published v5.0.14 tag and inspected dev head.

original_capability.authority: MIR4 reads the immutable, validated more-infinite-research-generation-plan public artifact and filters all rows whose action is skip and validated disposition inclusion is excluded, retaining stream, optional technology identity, reason and decision fingerprint.
original_capability.force_filter: MIR4 excludes omission rows when the omitted technology actually exists in the force.
original_capability.player_presentation: The third Research visibility mode validates the portable-research-omissions envelope and displays the selected omitted stream and specific reason, or explicit unavailable state for a bad envelope.

current_capability.authority: MIR5 availability.rows is a bounded authored finite list selected from missing Space Age, a precisely observed native research-productivity owner, and three exact Bob/Angel/Bob-core closures; it does not read a general generation-plan exclusion ledger.
current_capability.player_presentation: The third Research visibility mode uses availability.rows and displays authored terminal explanations. The English empty state explicitly says no authored availability explanations apply, not that no research was skipped.
current_capability.diagnostics: The optional omission section of the Help report reuses the same authored availability.rows, so it is not an independent complete ledger.

finding.verified: MIR4 could present any validated skip/excluded row of its published generation plan; MIR5's Availability only presents a fixed authored subset and cannot present an unlisted skip reason through that view. This is a change in the informational contract, independent of whether any specific current pack requires an unlisted reason.
not_verified: A specific current MIR5 modpack with an unlisted skip reason
User-visible loss for a specific predecessor save
Any research, queue, partial progress, bonus or other saved-state mutation
An unintended decision to delete the old behavior
finding.interpretation: MIR5 replaced the automatic compiler; reusing MIR4's plan envelope verbatim is not an implied remedy. Stable Library parity requires either a deliberately documented scope exception or a bounded equivalent source of omission explanations with faithful provenance.

finite_follow_up.requirement: Classify what MIR4 not-added explanation fidelity means under explicit MIR5 generation and record whether omission reason coverage is retained or intentionally reduced; do not conflate lack of an authored row with proof no stream was omitted.

For one currently supported, reproducible configuration with a skipped/generated candidate outside the three curated Bob closure sets, compare the actual generation decision to Library Availability without assuming a historical compiler exists; check that present and intentionally disabled technologies are not falsely described as absent.

Where the feature is applicable, verify real F200/F210 Library navigation/search, exact displayed explanation, selection ownership, stable frame/tab geometry, localization and input/export/client lifecycle on an actual native game; preserve published reports and all stable requirements.

verification.method: Exact GitHub blob readback and fifteen source-text/identity predicates; source-only, no Lua host control or Factorio native process.
validation_scope: mir4 public artifact lookup and skip/excluded filter
mir5 deliberate absence of broad compiler ledger
mir5 finite authored list and same-row Help export

ownership: Independent additive evidence only. Black Glass retains release14 integration/native/publication and angelbob_fix worker-history functionality; Aero retains Linux adapter/probe. No additional native run, accepted-test rerun, source/runtime edit, version bump, release or stable declaration authorized by this record.
disposition: Submit for ordinary independent review; retain MIR4 Library parity and whole-product stable gates open.
